newsitem.title: USA: Stein Mart to open 11 more stores in 1997.
newsitem.headline: Stein Mart to open 11 more stores in 1997.

text.p: Stein Mart Inc said on Thursday that it plans to open 11 more stores in 1997, giving it a total of 151 by the end of the year.
At the end of 1996, the company had 123 stores, Stein Mart said in a statement.
For the third quarter, Stein Mart will open eight stores, including the four open at Atlanta; Dallas; Gainesville, Fla.; and Longview, Texas.
New stores in Kansas City; Las Vegas, Nev.; Akron/Kent, Ohio; and Youngstown, Ohio will open by the end of September.
The 1997 store opening program should be complete by the end of October, the company said.
